newsitem.title: USA: Casino Magic riverboat sale scuttled.
newsitem.headline: Casino Magic riverboat sale scuttled.

text.p: Casino Magic Corp said on Tuesday that the California-based company, which had agreed to buy the Crescent City Queen riverboat for $12.25 million, does not intend to complete the deal.
On July 2, 1997, Casino Magic had announced the agreement to sell the Crescent City Queen riverboat
Casino Magic had intended to use proceeds from the sale to accelerate development of its Bossier City, Louisiana, riverboat casino which opened in October 1996, the company had said.
A Casino Magic spokesman said other parties are in talks with the company to acquire the riverboat.
The Crescent City Queen is a gaming vessel that is not presently being used and does not have any equipment on it, the spokesman said.
